posts.text: On June 10, PM Modi will complete 4,399 consecutive days in office — becoming India's longest-serving elected Prime Minister. A national assembly of coalition leaders will mark the historic milestone in New Delhi.
posts.caption: On June 10, PM Modi will complete 4,399 consecutive days in office — becoming India's longest-serving elected Prime Minister. A national assembly of coalition leaders will mark the historic milestone in New Delhi.

posts.text: One who is toiling should get profit. We are committed to empowering every driver, every worker across India. The Bharat Taxi initiative ensures dignity and fair returns for those who work hard every day.

posts.text: Promise vs Reality: Year 2 of Modi 3.0. Capital outflows, weak private investment, falling confidence, record-low rupee at 95 to the dollar, and India slipping to the world's sixth-largest economy. The government must absorb the oil price shock — don't pass the burden to consumers.

posts.text: Thank you to PM Modi Ji for the birthday wishes. Under the leadership of PM Modi, we are building a developed Uttar Pradesh. Six new ministers may join the UP cabinet as we accelerate development across the state.

posts.text: Paper leaks are a business worth billions and trillions. Very big-shot people are behind this racket. The Centre must answer — why can't they stop this? Students' futures are being destroyed while the government looks the other way.

posts.text: India's foreign policy remains firm: strategic autonomy, strong partnerships, and protecting our national interest. With the Strait of Hormuz situation evolving, we are ensuring India's energy security and supply chain resilience remain top priority.

posts.text: India's growth story continues. Sensex and Nifty rebounding as Middle East tensions ease. Our fundamentals remain strong — fiscal discipline, infrastructure investment, and digital public goods are driving sustained economic momentum.

posts.text: The Adani Group continues to grow across energy, infrastructure, and ports. Proud to be recognized as India's and Asia's richest on the Bloomberg Billionaire Index. Our commitment to nation-building through world-class infrastructure remains unwavering.

posts.text: Reliance is drawing up specific plans for mega-investments in the power sector, including clean coal, solar and nuclear power. We also plan massive capacity expansion in our core businesses and intensified oil and gas exploration.

posts.text: The Tata Group's legacy is built on trust, nation-building, and giving back to society. As India crosses new milestones in technology and industry, the values of ethical business and social responsibility must remain our guiding light.

posts.text: Paying tribute to Dharti Aaba Bhagwan Birsa Munda Ji on his Balidan Diwas. His indomitable courage and dedication to protecting the rights of tribal communities continue to inspire generations across India.

posts.text: Honored to address the curtain raiser for the India AI Impact Summit 2026. India and the UK share a deep partnership in technology and innovation. AI will define the next decade — and our democracies must lead responsibly.

posts.text: If you call Usha Vance a slur, you have no place in this movement. I reject extremism, Hitler glorification, and 'heritage American' ideology. The America First movement is about ideas and values — not race or ethnicity.
posts.caption: If you call Usha Vance a slur, you have no place in this movement. I reject extremism, Hitler glorification, and 'heritage American' ideology. The America First movement is about ideas and values — not race or ethnicity.

posts.text: Grateful for the support from across the country. As Second Lady, my focus remains on public service, supporting military families, and ensuring every community feels represented in this administration.
posts.caption: Grateful for the support from across the country. As Second Lady, my focus remains on public service, supporting military families, and ensuring every community feels represented in this administration.

posts.text: The FBI under my leadership is focused on what matters: protecting Americans from real threats. We've streamlined briefings and are modernizing how the Bureau operates. Reports to the contrary are hit pieces by those who want the status quo.
posts.caption: The FBI under my leadership is focused on what matters: protecting Americans from real threats. We've streamlined briefings and are modernizing how the Bureau operates. Reports to the contrary are hit pieces by those who want the status quo.

posts.text: The AI IPO season is here — SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic all racing to public markets. This is the most significant moment for tech capital markets since the dot-com era. The companies that build real products will define the next decade.
posts.caption: The AI IPO season is here — SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic all racing to public markets. This is the most significant moment for tech capital markets since the dot-com era. The companies that build real products will define the next decade.

posts.text: At the World Bank, we are accelerating climate finance and digital public infrastructure across the Global South. India's UPI model shows how technology can drive financial inclusion at scale — a blueprint for emerging economies worldwide.

posts.text: This government must go beyond incremental change. We must be the party of a stronger and fairer Britain. I'm leading a delegation of blue-chip British companies to China to strengthen trade and economic ties.
posts.caption: This government must go beyond incremental change. We must be the party of a stronger and fairer Britain. I'm leading a delegation of blue-chip British companies to China to strengthen trade and economic ties.

posts.text: Australia stands ready to work with partners across the Indo-Pacific on energy security and trade resilience. The Strait of Hormuz situation underscores why we must diversify our energy supply chains and invest in renewables.
posts.caption: Australia stands ready to work with partners across the Indo-Pacific on energy security and trade resilience. The Strait of Hormuz situation underscores why we must diversify our energy supply chains and invest in renewables.

posts.text: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting of 40+ nations exploring options for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran war ends. Peace and stability in the Middle East remain essential for global energy security.
posts.caption: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting of 40+ nations exploring options for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran war ends. Peace and stability in the Middle East remain essential for global energy security.

posts.text: The UAE continues to position itself as a global hub for AI, trade, and innovation. As tensions in the region ease, our focus remains on building bridges, growing our economy, and investing in the future of our people.

posts.text: Part of what we want to convey here is that there is not some magic that is necessary, that doesn't exist. A lot of this is technology we've already made for the Starlink V3 satellites. We don't think this is a super hard problem compared to the things we already do.

posts.text: I wish that I can tell you that I have a crystal ball plan for the next three years of how all this stuff is going to play out. I don't. I don't think anyone does. But AI is the most important investment Meta will ever make.
posts.caption: I wish that I can tell you that I have a crystal ball plan for the next three years of how all this stuff is going to play out. I don't. I don't think anyone does. But AI is the most important investment Meta will ever make.

posts.text: AI is reshaping every product we build at Google. From Search to Cloud to Gemini, we're making AI helpful for everyone. The pace of progress this year has been extraordinary — and we're just getting started.
posts.caption: AI is reshaping every product we build at Google. From Search to Cloud to Gemini, we're making AI helpful for everyone. The pace of progress this year has been extraordinary — and we're just getting started.

posts.text: Congrats Shantanu, on a legendary run at Adobe! You've built one of the most important software companies in the world, and expanded what's possible for creators, entrepreneurs, and brands everywhere.
posts.caption: Congrats Shantanu, on a legendary run at Adobe! You've built one of the most important software companies in the world, and expanded what's possible for creators, entrepreneurs, and brands everywhere.

posts.text: We've filed confidential IPO paperwork with the SEC. We expect it to leak so we're just announcing it. We're working to ensure the gains from AI are widely shared. Everyone should have an opportunity for a meaningful share in the prosperity AI creates.
posts.caption: We've filed confidential IPO paperwork with the SEC. We expect it to leak so we're just announcing it. We're working to ensure the gains from AI are widely shared. Everyone should have an opportunity for a meaningful share in the prosperity AI creates.

posts.text: At Apple, we've always believed that technology should be personal, powerful, and easy to use. The energy around Apple platforms has never been stronger. Developers are building more apps than ever, with well over 1,000 submissions to the App Store every hour.
posts.caption: At Apple, we've always believed that technology should be personal, powerful, and easy to use. The energy around Apple platforms has never been stronger. Developers are building more apps than ever, with well over 1,000 submissions to the App Store every hour.

posts.text: Compute is revenue. Compute is profit. At GTC Taipei, we showed how AI factories are becoming the new infrastructure for companies and countries. We are also working with LG on humanoid robotics — the future of physical AI is here.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — has transformed financial inclusion and governance at national scale. The next frontier is AI-powered public services that can reach every citizen.

posts.text: The AI IPO wave — SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic — signals a new era. But the real measure of AI's success won't be stock prices. It will be whether this technology helps solve the world's hardest problems: health, climate, and education.
posts.caption: The AI IPO wave — SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic — signals a new era. But the real measure of AI's success won't be stock prices. It will be whether this technology helps solve the world's hardest problems: health, climate, and education.

posts.text: IBM is doubling down on enterprise AI and hybrid cloud. Our clients are moving from AI experiments to production at scale. The companies that master AI agents and automation will define the next decade of business.
posts.caption: IBM is doubling down on enterprise AI and hybrid cloud. Our clients are moving from AI experiments to production at scale. The companies that master AI agents and automation will define the next decade of business.

posts.text: The sustainable advantage in AI cannot be just a model. It has to be the use cases of what people are doing with that model. India, with the world's largest future AI user base, can lead in data, privacy, security and trust.
posts.caption: The sustainable advantage in AI cannot be just a model. It has to be the use cases of what people are doing with that model. India, with the world's largest future AI user base, can lead in data, privacy, security and trust.

posts.text: Building great technology products requires deep focus and conviction. The AI transformation is real, and the founders and engineers who stay focused on solving hard problems — not just chasing hype — will create lasting value.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity alongside technology. AI should augment our artisans and designers, not replace them. The future of luxury lies in authentic craftsmanship elevated by innovation.

posts.text: Started the season with belief. Ended with back-to-back titles. This team lived every emotion together. The highs, the pressure, the hurdles, and the unwavering support. It feels extra special because… this place is HOME! ❤️

posts.text: Working hard on my recovery from the hamstring injury. The body needs time, but the mind is already focused on the bigger battles ahead — the England ODIs and the 2027 World Cup. Can't wait to be back on the field.
posts.caption: Working hard on my recovery from the hamstring injury. The body needs time, but the mind is already focused on the bigger battles ahead — the England ODIs and the 2027 World Cup. Can't wait to be back on the field.

posts.text: I've told CSK I'll be available for the next season. The recovery from the calf injury is going well. Still love stepping onto the field and giving it everything. The fire is still there. 🦁💛

posts.text: Resting from the T20I series isn't my choice — it's the BCCI's workload management plan. My eyes are on the 2027 ODI World Cup and the World Test Championship. I'll be ready when it matters most. The Asian Games are next on the calendar.
